purpose: Read omitted original diagnostic artifact members in pure functions memory solely to complete integrity/content inspection of an already downloaded and independently Python-validated archive.

trusted_manifest.authority: Exact per-member records supplied by root from independently reviewed Python byte readback; this helper author inspected metadata only.

usage.source_loading: Use only the exact independently reviewed source blobs and accepted hash helper. Do not execute any archive content as source.
usage.input: Root's already reconstructed exact ZIP bytes; no new artifact retrieval, source checkout, shell, package action or process is required or authorized.
usage.output: On complete verification return 17 raw Uint8Array log members plus metadata for all 19 omitted decoded members. Two public .deb members are checked only for exact length/CRC32/SHA256 and not returned/interpreted/executed.
usage.progress_bound: Compressed bit reads require source availability. Huffman traversal is at most15bits; dynamic lengths at most318; match copies at most258; output is bounded by supplied exact size. Each outer/data iteration consumes input bits or bounded output and malformed streams fail closed.
usage.index_checks: All63 central and local headers: exact trusted names/sizes/CRC; method0/8; supported version/flags; ASCII safe unique regular-file names; no encryption/ZIP64/multidisk; bounded extras; exact descriptors where used; contiguous nonoverlapping local records through central boundary; exact central count/end.
usage.integrity_checks: Whole original ZIP SHA before parsing; exact manifest SHA before JSON parse; all selected decoded lengths/CRC32/SHA256 before returning any logs.
usage.failure: Return FAILED_NO_LOGS_ADMITTED with errors and partial metadata, logs empty. Retain the failure record; do not treat any partial text as complete or patch/retry new decoder source without review.
usage.result_limit: Exact byte reconstruction alone is not semantic content acceptance, runtime qualification, repository-check compliance, source admission or gameplay permission.

non_actions: No ref or workflow event creation.
No original artifact bytes read by this author during preparation.
No process, filesystem, network or module access inside decoder/wrapper.
No generic extraction into paths or execution of data.
No new game, seed, calibration, engine case or fixture allocation.
preservation: These are unreferenced immutable source/review blobs at preparation time. Root may preserve the reviewed packet on an inert evidence lineage; no publication or event is created by this contract.
